verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an API-driven compliance SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack documents production APIs (alerts, cases, filings) and org-level API keys, but never mentions a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. The gated developer docs note states that no public sandbox documentation exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
